Great for all pets

Felt welcomed when I stepped in the office when I saw a personal welcome to Both Morticia and Gomez Meowski. Very thorough visit that left nothing out and all questions answered. It was their first visit at the end of the day and I didn't feel rushed.
Ahwatukee Commons always takes good care of my Syd.
These professionals know exactly what they’re doing. I trust them fully.
They were professional and compassionate. Both on the phone prior to going in and while we were there. They take great care of my cat.

Love this clinic! They’ve taken really good care of my vet-hating psychotic cat over the past 5 years and are always very friendly, informative and professional. Also, all the murals of animals doing human things are a nice touch.

Unfortunately this will be our last time taking our dog to this place. We had taken our pitbull here at least 3 times and had services done. Our dog has a ton anxiety, he just barks. We were giving medicine for his anxiety before but it didn't work, but we were still able to get his services done that day. This time we explained the medicine doesn't work, and that he does way better when we are not in the room. Dr.Elliot didn't even want to try, and refused to see him unless we reschedule and give him medicine that we'd have to pay for knowing it doesn't work. I've also explained that we've had their previous vets take care of our dog without the medicine and I didn't understand why Dr. Elliot wouldn't even try. Even the vet tech seemed like she didn't want to be around our dog, she even thought our dog was going to charge at another dog in the waiting room and I had to explain he's not vicious, he's just has alot of anxiety, he did exactly what I said and booked it out the building. If you have any "aggressive" breeds or animals that have a hard time at the vet, I'd day to stay clear of this place. They clearly don't listen to owners and will make excuses to not do their job. I understand dealing with animals can be a lot, but your a vet clinic, it's your job to help animals, making excuses to not see them is not the way to go about it.
Fantastic service as always.  The compassion of this office and team members is great.
Thank you so much for your feedback. We love having you as part of our family!
Thank you!
Very  caring and knowledable, reasonable price for services done
Angel and Dr Housely are amazing with Stark! They treat all of our pups like family :) I would definitely recommend everyone to bring their pets here

We’re new to the area and needed to find a new vet for Hank. From start to finish, the experience was fantastic. They gave Hank a thorough exam and helped me make informed decisions about his ongoing butt issues. The entire staff was incredibly kind and attentive. They reviewed his previous lab work from another vet and even called to explain what the results meant. When his fecal results came back, they provided a detailed explanation of the findings and what to expect moving forward. They were eager to answer all of my questions and made me feel completely supported. Dr. Housley and the staff that day were wonderful—highly recommend this practice!

The best veterinary clinic ever!
Everyone here is incredibly kind, friendly, and genuinely cares about both pets and their owners. They’re honest and to the point, which I really appreciate — no unnecessary upselling, just honest advice and top-notch care. The level of comfort and compassion they provide goes above and beyond. I’ve seen two different vets here, and both were absolutely spectacular! The vet techs are so compassionate — they’d give you and your pet the shirt off their back if they could. The front desk team is always happy, welcoming, and ready to help. I can’t recommend this clinic enough!
I have been bringing my babies to Ahwatukee Commons Veterinary Hospital for the past 11 years and I have ALWAYS been happy with the love and care they receive there

I moved here to Arizona a few years ago after living in both Virginia and California, and this is by far the BEST vet my senior pup jack jack has ever had. They are incredibly great with communication and are so kind and compassionate. I recommend every petsitting client to them and all of my friends. They even gave him a certificate of bravery after his dental procedure!

Wonderful office, has the most caring staff. You feel at home there, and you know that they’re there to assist you, and take care of the one that means the world to you.Dr. Housley is absolutely amazing!
The Ahwatukee commons Vets took very good care of my lil dog. Thank you
there a very friendly
They love my Mojito! 👍 …

I do feel they are extremely over priced. I wanted to set an appointment for a spay and was required to do a full blood panel, fecal test, up to date on vaccinations (which I can understand) and pay just to be seen.
Aside from that, I knew she had an ear / yeast infection and paid for that exam as well. When the young lady came back in and told me it would be 125 per ear (for medication. Excluding the ear exam) I let her know I’d rather go through chewy as it was 38 dollars for the bottle. (Yes longer prescription time but still worked and saved me 200 dollars.) I felt like I was arguing with her for 2-3 minutes before I finally said “I’m not going to keep going back and forth with you.”
The dr came back in and thoroughly explained the differences in prescriptions and allowed me to go through chewy. Which I greatly appreciated. But had the lady before been able to explain differences in product, timeframe for each and such, I do think it would have been a different experience and an easier process to “upsell.” I was already irritated. After my deposit I paid 400 dollars not including the chewy prescription. Mind you, majority of this was required to be done before I could even schedule / get a quote for the spay. They didn’t want to quote me on the spay until they made sure her blood panel came back appropriately. a few days later I called back for the quote and For the spay itself, They quoted me upwards of 730 for a 64 lb dog.
I have called 2 others who both are charging 290-375 including cone/e collar, anesthesia, a wash before the surgery and pain meds to take home.
And neither places required blood and fecal tests to be done before the spay.
So frustrating. I’m sure they’re lovely with your pets. But the wait times are absurd and they are 100% overcharging patients.

I have been bringing my pets to Dr. Elliot since 1981.  Now 40 years later I am still bringing my pets to her, Rebecca and her staff.  I love their sincere love and concern for my pets.  They have gone over and beyond for my pets.  I adopted a kitten at Pet Smart last year and my little Lovey had so many problems but it was too late I loved her. She had herpes in her eyes, parasites and tremors.  I love that they not only recommended specialty vets but also called to check ion her.  She is doing amazing now.  I know that people complain that vets cost too much but at Ahwatukee Commons they show you what their costs are and why.  I have Never felt that they suggested services that weren’t needed.  I highly recommend them.

I have been a client of Ahwatukee Commons since I moved to Phoenix 9 years ago. I feel my pets, including dogs and cats, have received excellent care by both doctors Elliot and Housley. I highly recommend Ahwatukee Commons.

New team members very caring, professional and honest about needs. All while considering I was on a budget. My favorite is the Welcome Board with my babies names on it!!!Awww...Abbey & Pablo. I feel like the best Dog Mom when i take them there!
Great vet to take my dogs too. The staff is very friendly and the vet explained everything I’d need to know about my new puppy

So far very happy, Dr Elliott answered all questions we had, took her time. Front office staff friendly and efficient. Treated our new puppy Remi, intend on going back. Thank you.
